load_models_from_checkpoint: load sender models from a POP experiment checkpoint and set them to eval mode on the specified device
create_LinearClassifier: create a simple linear classifier PyTorch module with configurable input and output dimensions
train_epoch_classifier: train a classifier for one epoch using a sender model, dataloader, optimizer, and loss criterion
test_epoch_senders: test classifier accuracy across multiple sender models on a validation dataloader and return per-sender accuracies
test_classification_accuracy: test the classification accuracy of a model on a test dataset and return the percentage of correct predictions
